lines.text: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and the LORD is Maker of the rich and the poor.
The prudent see danger and take cover, and the rewards of humility and the fear of the LORD are wealth, honor and life.
A child trained in the way he should go will not depart from it, and the borrower is master to the lender.
He who sows injustice will reap disaster, and the slacker says there is a storm outside.
The rod of discipline drives foolishness far from a child, and oppressing the poor or giving gifts to the rich leads to poverty.
